## Downloads

- **Windows**: the `-Windows-x64.zip`, unzip and run `PocketSoundMixer.exe`. Per-app channels need Windows 11, or Windows 10 build 20348 or newer.
- **macOS** and **Linux**: the `.tar.gz` for your platform. These builds compile and pass the automated tests but have not been tried by the repository owner. Only the Mic channel works there for now.

## Good to know

- Audio from apps you add to a channel, including the other people in a voice chat app, goes through that channel's equalizer.
- The Mic channel's equalizer only changes what the mixer plays. Other apps still receive your microphone as it is.

See the [user guide](https://github.com/enesozdin/PocketSoundMixer/blob/main/docs/USER_GUIDE.md) ([Türkçe](https://github.com/enesozdin/PocketSoundMixer/blob/main/docs/USER_GUIDE.tr.md)).
